text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Japan Cup she had promised 
Cheval Grand they'd run together, her 
childhood friend Shine Praise suffered a 
serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To continue running in the future, the 
only choice is to undergo surgery with low 
odds of success. Hearing the terrified 
voice of her childhood friend, Cheval 
Grand makes a firm resolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Chevalier Grand appeared on a 
special broadcast featuring contenders 
running in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the world—and to her childhood friend 
across the ocean, Cheval Grand declared 
that she would deliver courage through a 
victory at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the introverted girl's passionate 
declaration of victory, anticipation for 
an all-out clash on the grand stage grew 
higher and higher.
